transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... for nearly two years now, I’ve been absolutely sure that our contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and those people keep giving us all sorts of excuses, but... I just know what they're doing.
Can you tell me more about why you believe the contractor and your neighbors are working against you, even though your husband has shown you receipts and they have given explanations?

Well, like I said, it’s been nearly two years of this. My husband looks at the paperwork, but... receipts don't really mean anything when you can see what's actually happening right in front of you. Anyone can write up a bill or come up with a good excuse. 

I just know they are in on it together. The contractor and those neighbors are quietly coordinating the whole thing just to cheat us out of our money. That's why the kitchen is still sitting there half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many times they try to explain it away or how many pieces of paper my husband shows me, I know exactly what they're doing.
Have you ever experienced any unusual sensations, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't?
No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I know what you're getting at, but... no, nothing like that at all. My mind is perfectly fine.
Have you ever had any strange or unusual ideas that other people might find hard to understand, even if they seem completely obvious to you?

No, not really. I mean, other than what I just told you about the contractor and the neighbors. That's not a strange idea, though, that's just the truth of what's happening to me. But as far as other weird ideas or things like that... no, I haven't had anything like that. Just this situation with my kitchen.

Even though your husband has shown you receipts and the contractor and neighbors have given explanations, do you believe, without any doubt, that they are deliberately working together against you despite all evidence saying otherwise?

Yes, absolutely without a doubt. I know I've said it already, but that's exactly why I'm here. For nearly two years now, I’ve been completely sure that the contractor and those people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me or how many excuses they give. I know what they're doing.
